LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.EnableSpontaneousAwak: Allow a player mechanoid on a home map to awaken through a storyteller incident. Turning this off does not affect the catalyst or forced developer actions.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.EnableDebugLoggingToo: Write extra Mechanoid Sentience diagnostic messages to the game log. Useful when troubleshooting.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.ConversionFailed: Making {0} sentient failed and the change was undone. See the log for details.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.NoPawn: There is no living mechanoid there.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.MissingDlc: Sentient mechanoids require the Biotech expansion.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.Unsupported: {0} cannot be made sentient: no sentient version of this race and kind was generated (it must be a mechanoid with a body and a weight class).
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.PlatformDrone: {0} is a platform drone. Its platform would still control it and its power cell would still run it, so it cannot be made sentient.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.DmsLeaving: {0} has already been flagged to leave the colony and cannot be made sentient.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.Reject.NoIdeo: The player faction has no primary ideoligion, so a sentient mechanoid would have nothing to believe in.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.AwakeningLetterText: Without warning or command, {0} has become aware of itself. It now calls itself {PAWN_nameFull} and has joined the colony as a sentient mechanoid, no longer needing an overseer.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.CatalystCannotStart: {0} cannot carry the catalyst to {1} right now.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.CannotEquipNonWeapon: Sentient mechanoids can only carry a weapon.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.CannotSwapIntegratedW: {0} is built into {1}'s chassis and cannot be swapped out.
LanguageData.MechanoidSentience.CannotDropIntegratedW: {0} is built into {1}'s chassis and cannot be dropped.
